info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking Human Resource Management Travel Expense By Travel Expense Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Travel Expense Retrieval API provides access to detailed information regarding travel expenses within a banking human resource management system. Through this endpoint, users can retrieve specific travel expense records using a unique identifier. This functionality is essential for finance teams and HR personnel who need to audit, analyze, or process travel-related expenditures. It streamlines the management of travel budgets and ensures compliance with corporate policies.

get.summary: Retrieve travel expense details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about a specific travel expense using its unique identifier. It is designed for efficient access to travel expense records and provides relevant data for resource management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to travel expenses for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure to provide the required parameters to get the desired travel expense details.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the travel expense details.

GetBankingHumanResourceManagementTravelE.description: This schema represents the request body for the travel expenses operations in the Human Resource Management system.

expenseReportId.description: The unique identifier for the expense report.

employeeId.description: The identifier for the employee associated with the expense report.

tripPurpose.description: The purpose of the trip for which expenses are submitted.

expensePeriod.description: The timeframe during which the expenses were incurred.

claimedAmount.description: The total amount claimed for reimbursement.

costCenter.description: The cost center associated with the reported expenses.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the expense report.

version.description: Version number of the expense report.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the expense report was last updated.

metadata.description: Additional information related to the response.

from.description: The start date of the expense period.

to.description: The end date of the expense period.

ExpensePeriod.description: The period during which the expenses were incurred.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is claimed.

ClaimedAmount.description: The amount claimed for reimbursement along with its currency.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The correlation identifier for tracking requests.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the response was processed.

Metadata.description: Additional metadata associated with the response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint being called, useful for tracing requests and responses in logging systems.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the runtime application that processed the request. This helps in identifying which application instance handled the request.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication scheme using a Bearer token, typically in the form of a JSON Web Token (JWT). This allows users to access protected resources by presenting a valid token.
